```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
library(bslib)
```


```{r}
## app.R ##

## Define UI ##
ui_1 <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Very Creative Title Here"),  # Optional title
  
  dashboardSidebar(  # Sidebar with tabs
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Visual 1", tabName = "Visual 1", icon = icon("chart-bar")),
      menuItem("Visual 2", tabName = "Visual 2", icon = icon("chart-bar"))
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(  # Main body content
    tabItems(
      # First tab content
      tabItem(tabName = "Visual 1",
        fluidRow(
          box(plotOutput("plot1", height = 250)),

          box(
            title = "Controls",
            sliderInput("slider", "Number of observations:", 1, 100, 50)
          )
        )
      ),

      # Second tab content
      tabItem(tabName = "Visual 2",
        h2("Average Response Time by Borough")
      )
    )
  )
)


```


```{r}
## Define Server ##
server_1 <- function(input, output) {
  set.seed(122)
  histdata <- rnorm(500)
  
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    data <- histdata[seq_len(input$slider)]
    hist(data)
  })
}

## Run the App ##
shinyApp(ui_1, server_1)
```
